thread:
Kaitlyn: Postmortem follow-up for the morning spike. Root cause summary (short): malformed cert bundle concatenation at upload + aggressive DNS low TTLs caused rapid cache churn + increased cross-region retry amplification. Details in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/x/pmtu-dns-2026

Omar: Observed 4x retry amplification from ap-south -> us-central during the 07:10 UTC window. LB logs show aborted TLS handshakes often after the ServerHello when chain size > 3.

Yusuf: Historical note: we had similar symptoms in Q4 2025 but it was dismissed as transient. We should track recurrence patterns and tag related incidents.

Kaitlyn: Agreed. Proposed immediate actions and owners below. Keep replies short so we can rollover to the incident board.

incidents-bot: Action created: INC-2026-6012 "Cert-bundle + DNS churn postmortem" assigned to Kaitlyn, due 2026-03-26 18:00 UTC.

Kaitlyn: Owners (draft):
- Omar: edge upload validation and LB handshake resilience patch + canary (due 2026-03-25 22:00 UTC)
- Yusuf: DNS provider failover playbook + increase public TTLs to 180s for affected zones (due 2026-03-25 14:00 UTC)
- Lina-netops: PMTU/middlebox trace + pcap analysis (due 2026-03-25 20:00 UTC)
- Kaitlyn: runbook updates, incident tags, and monthly recurrence tracking (due 2026-03-26 18:00 UTC)

Omar: Opening PR: https://github.com/redwood/edge/pull/489. Patch adds size checks on uploaded bundles and falls back to single-cert mode when combined chain length > 1.5KB. Canary on edge-pool-3.

Kaitlyn: Nice. Add a CI test that uploads a 2.5KB bundle to exercise the code path.

Omar: Will add. Quick sanity command I used to reproduce the handshake abort locally:
```
openssl s_client -connect edge.redwood-inference.com:443 -showcerts < large-bundle.pem
```
Failed handshake shows truncated chain in the early-debug log.

Lina-netops: Running mtr and tcpdump now from ap-south egress node. Command snippets:
```
mtr -rz -c 100 us-central-egress.example.net
sudo tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/egress-20260324.pcap host 1.2.3.4 and port 443 and "tcp[tcpflags] & tcp-push != 0"
```
I'll post the pcap and a quick hop list when done.

Yusuf: Implementing provider failover steps and TTL bump. Applied change in staging: TTL 60 -> 180 and enabled parallel failover routing for provider-B. Monitoring DNS query rates and cache-hit metrics now.

Kaitlyn: Also: add a regression alert that fires if "cross_region_tls_aborts" > 0.2% for 10m. No pager unless >1% for 5m. We'll add to ops-alerting.

incidents-bot: Alert rule proposal added to ops-alerting as AR-2026-78.

Omar: Canary results so far: edge-pool-3 shows 0.3% aborts (was 1.8%). Rolling patch to edge-pool-1 next.

Lina-netops: PMTU note: saw ICMP fragmentation-needed replies on a handful of hops for packets >1392B. Suspect middlebox rewriting MSS on the path. Captured traceroutes attached to the incident board.

Yusuf: FYI I've queued a DNS scheduled change for 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC to rotate provider A -> provider-B for affected subzones. I left a rollback window of 30 minutes.

Kaitlyn: Follow-ups timeline: weekly recurrence review next 3 weeks (Wednesdays 13:00 UTC) to detect pattern. I'll create a tracking dashboard for related incident tags (cert-chain, pmtu, dns-churn).

Omar: Requesting review on the PR; reviewers @Kaitlyn and @Lina-netops.

Yusuf: I'll add a synthetic test that requests a large cert chain and asserts stability from multiple regions. Proposed wrk command in CI:
```
wrk -t8 -c100 -d30s https://edge.redwood-inference.com/large-cert-test
```

Kaitlyn: Thanks all. Owners & deadlines reposted to the incident board. Please mark done in the board when complete. Short status call tomorrow 09:00 UTC if anything regresses.

incidents-bot: This thread will be archived under /incidents/2026/1765439999 for audit."
